Question 1
?

For what reason does the function f(x) below have a discontinuity at x=−1? f(x)={x3+x,x<−1x2+1,x≥−1

a
f(x) is a piecewise function
b
limx→−1−f(x)≠limx→−1+f(x)
c
limx→−1f(x)≠f(−1)
d
f(−1) does not exist
e
limx→−1+f(x) does not exist
